capabilities: remove notices after a configurable startup delay
keep notices persistent by setting the delay to zero
configure the delay through a settings tab
disambiguation: Not a general notification system; it only removes existing notices after startup, it does not create or route notifications.
problem: Obsidian displays debug startup time notices from community plugins on launch, which clutter the interface until manually dismissed.
summary: Utility plugin that removes Obsidian notices, especially community plugin debug startup time notices, after a configurable delay.
